test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March-April 2021, the state legislative assembly elections were held in four Indian states. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
solution:
The correct answer is __Karnataka__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Legislative assembly

 
 
• In the Indian system of government , a representative who is elected to the legislature of the state government is known as a member of the legislative assembly (MLA).
 
• The voters choose one representative from each constituency, who subsequently joins the legislative assembly (MLA).
 
• In India, elections will be held in 2021 for the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, legislative assemblies of four states and one union territory, as well as other municipal, state, and federal councils, committees, and legislative assemblies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Assam 

 
 
• The 2021 Assam Legislative Assembly election was the 15th quinquennial legislative assembly election held in the Indian state of Assam from March 27 to April 6 in three phases, to elect 126 MLAs to the 15th Assam Legislative Assembly.
 
 
 
• Kerala
 
 
• The election for the 140 members of the 15th Kerala Legislative Assembly was held on April 6, 2021, in Kerala.
 
• On May 2, the results were made public.
 
 
 
• West Bengal
 
 
• The 2021 West Bengal Legislative Assembly election was held between March 27 and April 29, 2021, in eight phases, for 292 of West Bengal's 294 constituencies.
